blocking_findings.finding: The 36-launch ceiling is enforced per selected ledger, not across the campaign. A retry with a new output directory defaults to a fresh ledger; subsequent stages can also select a different ledger. Failed launches remain counted only in the original ledger.
blocking_findings.required_change: Bind the campaign to one persistent ledger outside individual attempt directories, preserve that identity across stages and retries, and reject ledger substitution. Add coverage for retries and stage transitions.

blocking_findings.finding: The grid reads config-used.json, but identity verification covers frozen-source/inputs/config.json instead. Changing the working configuration after snapshot therefore passes identities() and can change the approved 24-point catalogue. The claimed frozen configuration is not the configuration actually consumed by the grid.
blocking_findings.required_change: Consume the hash-verified frozen configuration, or verify the working configuration against it before use. Add a configuration-mutation rejection test.

nonblocking_findings.finding: Nonfinite density inputs return before audit-counter increments. They are rejected, but counters are not exhaustive records of invalid calls. Counts also include diagnostic density reevaluation.

Thermal codes are emitted but not checked against expected values. Water phase expectations use native dispatch; independent analytical branch checking is implemented for Fe. These distinctions should remain explicit in the actual-result audit.

Assigning recomputed direct-sample fractions immediately after dictionary construction is semantically correct. Supplied fractions are not read. The previous placement objection is not a code blocker; this does not revise the historical verdict.

verified_evidence: Review was read-only. No planet/model, native probe, build, or file-writing controller fixture was launched.
Independently recomputed hashes: all 31 entries in evidence/current-file-sha256.json and all 40 entries in validated-source.json match local files.
Reviewed all nine supplied source-file diffs against evidence/baseline/src, the controller, helpers, independent checker, exact configuration, and test sources.
check-0/1/2.log contain the recorded 144-probe pass and main compilation/linking output. Build warnings are present. These are inspected historical execution records, not fresh execution claims.
Fresh read-only execution of python -B tests/test_pilot_grid.py passed all 13 tests, including poisoned supplied fractions.
Inspected the recorded four-controller-test pass. Those fixtures cover one-ledger exhaustion, frozen-file mutation, existing-output refusal, and D-only paths; they do not cover the blocking findings.
Legacy regression evidence records 28 settings assertions, eight diagnostic I/O checks, and the wrong-phase serialization guard. Its earlier diagnostic version limits its applicability.

Native inspection confirms uniform existing Gas_hhe dispatch, opt-in strict density/gradient table bounds, symbol-based pointer IDs, zero-mass component skipping, schema2 serialization of every accepted row, and counters captured after density reevaluation.

The checker covers center material, component mass intervals, accepted-row ordering/domain/density consistency, independent HHe bilinear lookup with legacy float-loaded axes, external TP consistency, and raw normalized fit residuals.

The controller reserves before each native launch, records failures and artifact hashes, applies 180-second timeouts, stops on single-stage failures, requires tight-radius agreement, and rechecks five saved cases before grid execution.
scientific_limits: No blocking solver/EOS defect was identified in the inspected changes; the combined verdict is withheld for controller budget and configuration-integrity defects.
Approval after correction would mean READY FOR BOUNDED SINGLE-CASE RUN only. No runtime numerical or physical gate has passed here.
Fe_default and water_default remain conditional prescriptions. Numerical bounds do not establish empirical validity, phase stability, or thermodynamic consistency across seams.
Existing thermal closures remain, including thermal_type 0 behavior for Fe_liquid2 and IceX.
The example external TP scenario uses fixed mass 8.04 Earth masses, target radius 2.39 Earth radii, radius-only interval [2.28, 2.49], and surface pressure 0.1 bar at 350 K.
Unsupported TP/domain cases are numerical holes, not observational exclusions. Coarse crossings remain unconfirmed; no posterior or empirical-validation claim is justified.
Actual single-stage results require independent audit before the sparse 24-point grid.
